# Manikkavasagar and the horses at Perunthurai

`n-manikkavasagar` | Other Tamil Shaiva saints and poets | 1 songs

Sent by the Pandya king to buy horses, the minister Vathavurar met Shiva as a guru at Tiruperunthurai under the kurundam tree and gave the money to build the temple. The horses came later as foxes turned horses.
